title: redstono's recipes back port
description: this data pack adds the new recipes from minecraft 1.21.6 and above
body:
# 1.21+ Recipe Backport Datapack

Bring the future of Minecraft crafting into your favorite modded worlds! 

This datapack bridges the version gap by backporting crafting recipes from Minecraft **1.21.6 and above** directly into older versions of the game.

## Why use this datapack?
Many massive content mods—like the **Create Mod**—are firmly rooted in stable versions like **1.20.1**. If you want to build complex automated factories but still want access to the latest vanilla items and crafting mechanics introduced in the newer updates, this pack handles it seamlessly.

## Features
* **Modern Recipe Backport:** Adds official crafting recipes from version 1.21.6+ into your current game.
* **Modpack Friendly:** Designed specifically to work alongside major version-locked mods without breaking existing progression.
* **Lightweight:** Vanilla-friendly implementation that won't impact server or client performance.

## Installation
1. Download the datapack zip file.
2. Open your Minecraft world folder.
3. Drop the zip file into the `datapacks` folder.
4. If you are already in-game, type `/reload` to activate the new recipes!
